_comment: Ed25519 public keys trusted to sign an Azazel-Fabric release-candidate
EMPTY ON PURPOSE. No release has been signed yet, and an empty list is
the honest statement of that: tools/rc_signature.py fails closed on it
and reports the candidate as unsigned, which is what it is.
To trust a key, add "<key_id>": "<64 hex chars>". The id is free-form
and appears in the .sig file; the value is the 32-byte Ed25519 PUBLIC
key, hex-encoded. A private key never belongs in this repository.
The format is Azazel-Knowledge's (bundle/verify.py), reused so one
